preconditions.expression: all(1 <= L[i] <= R[i] <= N for i in range(N))
preconditions.description: Each L[i] and R[i] are between 1 and N inclusive, and L[i] is less than or equal to R[i].

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= x <= N and 1 <= y <= N for x, y in queries)
preconditions.description: Each query (x, y) has x and y between 1 and N inclusive.

postconditions.description: The output contains exactly Q lines.

postconditions.expression: all(output[i] in ['E', 'O'] for i in range(Q))
postconditions.description: Each line of the output is either 'E' or 'O'.

postconditions.expression: all((sum(matrix[i][j] for i in range(N) for j in range(N) if i != x-1 and j != y-1) % 2 == 0) == (output[i] == 'E') for i, (x, y) in enumerate(queries))
postconditions.description: The output 'E' indicates that the sum of the matrix excluding the x-th row and y-th column is even, and 'O' indicates that it is odd.
